findings.body: The new proofs still fabricate `AskResponse` objects through `mocks.ask` and exercise them only in Vitest/jsdom. The repository has no Playwright dependency, configuration, or test command, so nothing drives these user-facing results through a browser, the running Ask API, a real database, and an authenticated user. Consequently the required boundary cannot detect serialization or integration failures affecting plant readouts, budget dashes/left-out notices, or row-specific transaction links. Add a committed Playwright flow covering Done-when 5–7 through the actual Ask entry point.
